decisions.reason: The candidate's message-143 INTRODUCE already states that prize wins appear on the Winners page and are claimable with one click, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The candidate already records the Winners page as the announcement channel; adding a one-click claim action does not change the announcement requirement.
The prize claim location and action do not change Big Block prize amounts, draw triggers, funding, eligibility, or post-draw ticket handling.
The prize claim location and action do not change Small Block prize amounts, draw cadence, funding, eligibility, or post-draw ticket handling.
Providing one-click prize claims on the Winners page does not alter the Chainlink VRF winner-selection method or its verification properties.
The claim-flow decision does not change how tickets are allocated when a mint has no referral code.
The claim-flow decision does not change the trigger, recipient, quantity, or lifecycle of tickets issued for code-used mints.
The Winners-page one-click claim flow does not alter either ticket counter or its reset semantics.
The claim-flow decision does not change the requirement to expose prize-pool values through unauthenticated public APIs.
The source distinguishes automatic wallet delivery of commissions from one-click collection of prize wins, leaving the referral commission requirement unchanged.
The prize claim action and location do not change referral-code identity, permanence, sharing, display, or resale behavior.
The prize claim-flow decision does not change the mint price, founder share, referral commission allocation, or prize-pool funding destinations.
